name: Moa — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Moa from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Mythic Moa" but are not part of the Moa entry, which is unchanged.

Charger (Ex)

A mythic moa gains the trample and stampede universal monster abilities.

Additionally, when a group of three or more mythic moas stampede, for each mythic moa that expends one use of mythic power as part of the stampede, the damage inflicted by the trample increases by 1d6, and the trample’s DC increases by +1.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm plains
Organization solitary, pair, groupd (3–5), or colony (6–100)
